description: Look up how a portfolio, strategy or fund actually returned: seasonality by calendar month (average return, share of positive months, number of years and a t-statistic so a thin 'September effect' is not presented as a law), calendar-year returns with partial years labelled (optionally next to the S&P 500), trailing 1/3/5/10/20/30-year returns, and the best and worst year and month. Use it for 'is September bad for 60/40', 'what did All Weather return in 2022', 'how has SPY done over 10 years', 'what did my own portfolio return each year'. Pass exactly one of `template` (e.g. all-weather, classic-60-40), `strategy` (e.g. dual-momentum-gem), `ticker` (any Yahoo ticker) or `assets` (your own allocation, including nested portfolios, rotations and strategies as holdings via `sleeve`, with optional `rebalance` and `overlay`); list_portfolios shows every valid id. Built-in ids and the funds with a history page are precomputed from the monthly refresh (instant); other tickers and `assets` are computed live from market data (proxy-extended monthly total returns). Read-only; every answer says which month the data runs through. For risk and drawdowns use portfolio_risk; to compare portfolios use compare_portfolios.

assets.description: Your own allocation instead of an id, computed live (monthly composition, proxy-extended). Same format as analyze_portfolio: plain tickers and nested portfolios, rotations or strategies via `sleeve`. Weights in percent, summing to ~100.

sleeve.description: Advanced: a strategy node instead of a plain ticker — the app's SleeveRef, resolved server-side. Supported: a rotation/selection (`{source:'selection', config:{universe:[{ticker}], signal:{kind:'indicator', indicatorId, params} | {kind:'trailing-return', lookbackMonths, skipMonths (>= 1; the ranking for a month only sees data through the previous month-end)}, topK, weighting, rebalance}, label}`), a strategy-over-node (`{source:'strategy-over', child:{ticker}, config:<BacktestConfig>, label}`), a saved strategy preset (`{source:'backtest-live', ticker, frequency, config, presetId, label}`), a curated public-library strategy (`{source:'backtest-public', strategyId, label}`), a published backtest share (`{source:'backtest-share', shareId, label}`), a gallery template (`{source:'portfolio-public', templateId, label}`), or a nested portfolio (`{source:'portfolio-mine', portfolioId, config, label}`). Strategies with a config get a node-level overfit check (a share carries only its frozen curve, so no overfit).

ticker.description: Yahoo Finance ticker, e.g. VTI, BND, GLD. Omit when `sleeve` is given.

benchmark.description: 'sp500' adds S&P 500 (SPY, proxy-extended) columns over the same months and the difference. Default sp500.

label.description: Optional display name for a custom `assets` portfolio. Default "Custom portfolio".

overlay.description: Optional portfolio-level trend-filter overlay applied to the WHOLE book: hold the entire portfolio only while its own level is above its N-month moving average, otherwise cash. Composition is monthly (a 10-month filter ≈ the classic 200-day one).

rebalance.description: Rebalancing cadence for custom portfolios (templates use their own).

sections.description: Which tables to return: seasonality, calendar_years, trailing. Default: all three.

strategy.description: Canonical rule-based strategy id, e.g. 'dual-momentum-gem' or 'faber-trend-timing'. list_portfolios shows all 7.

template.description: Built-in model portfolio id, e.g. 'all-weather' or 'classic-60-40'. list_portfolios shows all 19.

ticker.description: A Yahoo Finance ticker, e.g. SPY, VTI, TLT, AAPL. Funds held by the built-in portfolios or with a history page are precomputed; any other ticker is computed live (proxy-extended where a proxy chain exists).

years.description: Limit the calendar-year table to the most recent N years (e.g. 10). Default: all years.

name: portfolio_returns
